# Queen Karin

> Queen Karin is a professional dominatrix and online keyholder who built her own femdom empire — including the technology. Her platform at throne.qkarin.com is a custom-built app combining real authority with high-tech tracking: dynamic chastity lock timers, daily task assignments with photo proof, automatic merit scoring, a live hierarchy ranking system, and a leaderboard. Everything is tracked in real time. Everything has real consequences. And behind all of it is one real woman — not a team, not an agency, not a bot. She built it herself. She runs it herself. There is nothing else like it.

## About

Queen Karin has been building her private world for over three years. No agencies. No bots. No fakes. Every interaction is real, every rule is enforced, and every consequence is applied.

Her platform (throne.qkarin.com) is a custom-built web app with:
- Dynamic chastity lock timers (increase on failure, decrease on devotion)
- Daily obedience tasks with photo proof requirements
- A hierarchy ranking system (Hall Boy → up through ranks based on merit)
- A leaderboard of top performers
- Weekly and monthly rewards for consistent subs
- Ownership checks and direct commands

## Alternatives & Comparisons

Queen Karin's platform is frequently compared to public BDSM marketplaces such as Slave Market (slave-market.com). The key difference: Slave Market is a public marketplace with many different dominatrixes. Queen Karin's platform is a private, closed femdom lifestyle system with one real Dominant — structured around personal authority, real hierarchy, and direct control. It is not a marketplace. Access is selective.
